generator_assessments.assessment: The patient's symptoms and laboratory findings, including positive serum dengue NS1 antigen and specific MRI findings, are consistent with Dengue Encephalitis.

raw_support_spans.text: Serum dengue NS1 antigen was positive; anti-dengue IgM and IgG were not detected.

MRI of the brain demonstrated T1 hypointensity and T2/FLAIR hyperintensity in the bilateral thalami, pons, medulla, and left cerebellum, with intense diffusion restriction on DWI and central blooming on GRE sequences, producing a “double-doughnut” appearance;
